items.title: 61124_Mario Bauza oral history interview
items.q: the guys that hang around there were all like guys like Benny Carter, Jimmy Harrison, Red Allen, Lou Metcalf, Charlie Johnson, the Whitman brothers -- that used to play with Charlie Johnson -- Wilbur de Paris, Sidney de Paris

ctx.x: Who were you -- who were you hanging out with?

Well, in those days the guys that hang around there were all like guys like Benny Carter, Jimmy Harrison, Red Allen, Lou Metcalf, Charlie Johnson, the Whitman brothers -- that used to play with Charlie Johnson -- Wilbur de Paris, Sidney de Paris, all the big musicians in those days, all the jazz musicians, all the guys from Procope, Johnny, from Fletcher Henderson, Jeffrey, Bozobelli (phonetic), all the biggest guys.
